newsitem.title: POLAND: SOCCER-POLISH DEFENDER TO TRAIN WITH RANGERS.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-POLISH DEFENDER TO TRAIN WITH RANGERS.

text.p: Polish defender Pawel Wojtala will spend two weeks training with Glasgow Rangers later this month and could be sold to the Scottish champions for about $1.5 million.

"There were talks with several clubs and Glasgow Rangers indicated they were interested, so Wojtala is going there for two weeks starting on January 26," said Roman Jakobczak, deputy chief at the player's club Lech Poznan.
